data.name: Aureliah
data.long_meaning: The name Aureliah is derived from the Latin word 'aureus', which means 'golden'. It was a common name for Roman girls, symbolizing prosperity and wealth. In Christianity, this name is associated with Saint Aurelia, a third-century martyr who was thrown into a lake with a millstone around her neck but was saved by an angel.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes prosperity, wealth, and divine protection.
data.numerology_meaning: Aureliah is a name that resonates with the vibration of the number 9. It is a name that represents the humanitarian and spiritual nature of the person born with this name. They are often called to serve others and to make the world a better place.

in_greek.name: Αὐρηλία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αὐρηλία προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη Aurelia, η οποία με τη σειρά της προέρχεται από το όνομα Aurelius. Ο Αυρηλίας Προυντίος Κλήμενας ήταν επισκοπος της Ρώμης τον 5ο αιώνα. Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Αὐρηλία σχετίζεται με τον τίτλο της κυρίας ή πριγκίπισσας. Η ονομασία αυτή συνδέεται επίσης με την ιδέα της σοβαρότητας, της σοφίας και της αρετής.

in_latin.name: Aureliah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aureliah derivatum est a vocabulo Latinico Aurelia, quod autem a nomine masculino Aurelius ortum est. Aurelius Prudentius Clemens, episcopus Romanus saeculi quinti, in litteris sanctis notus est. In traditione Christiana, nomen Aureliah significat regem aut principem feminam. Haec nomen etiam ad gravitatem, prudentiam, et virtutem referuntur.

in_english.name: Aureliah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aureliah originates from the Latin name Aurelia, which in turn is derived from the male name Aurelius. This name is also associated with gravity, prudence, and virtue.

Aureliah's story inspires us to follow in her footsteps, to remain true to our faith in the face of adversity, and to strive for the golden virtues of the Christian faith.
